title: Newer WebGPU features on element textures
blurb: A form and a block of text as WebGPU textures, drawn with texture swizzle, immediates, a float trail target, primitive_index and dual-source blending. Each has another way for devices without it, a compatibility mode tier and a WebGL route.
question: Which newer WebGPU features are useful on a texture made from an element, and what is drawn on a device without them?
